{"caption":"A three-part schematic compares separate memory systems with a unified agentic approach to managing short- and long-term memory.","description":"The diagram has three side-by-side panels. Each starts with a Query card reading “Which band has more members, Muse or The Raconteurs?” and a Session Content card listing “1. Narcissus (band) … 2. The Raconteurs … 3. Sundae Club …”. Each panel ends with an LLM Answer card showing “<answer> The Raconteurs. </answer>”.

In the left panel, the query points downward to Static Short-term Memory, which contains Query, Retrieved Memories, and Context. Session Content points downward to Trigger-based Long-term Memory, which has Add memory, Update memory, and Delete memory operations. Between the memory stores, an orange arrow points from short-term to long-term memory and is labelled Memory storage; a return arrow points from long-term to short-term memory and is labelled Memory retrieval. A downward arrow leads from short-term memory to the LLM answer. A dashed grey path labelled Multi-round responses loops from the answer area back toward the memory/context area. In a separate dashed box labelled Independent construction, two person icons independently point down to Short-term Memory and Long-term Memory; a red X marks the crossed connection between the two stores.

The middle panel again has Static Short-term Memory, with Query, Retrieved Memories, and Context. Session Content points down to a Memory Manager box, which shows an example operation with action “add” and content “Narcissus …”. A rightward arrow labelled Memory storage connects short-term memory to the manager; a downward arrow labelled Memory operation leads from the manager to Agent-based Long-term Memory. A leftward arrow labelled Memory retrieval runs from the long-term store back to short-term memory. A downward arrow leads to the LLM answer, and a dashed grey Multi-round responses path returns toward the memory/context area. Its lower Independent construction box again shows separate person-to-store arrows and a red X between short- and long-term memory.

In the right panel, the query and session content point down into Agentic Memory Management. Inside it, an agent icon sits above two tool boxes: Short-term Memory Tools and Long-term Memory Tools. The tools connect downward to Agentic Context and Agentic Memory, respectively; the connections are annotated Tools calling & Memory operation. A pink dashed upward path beside the long-term tools is labelled Memory retrieval tool. Agentic Context points down to the LLM answer, with Multi-round responses marked beside the return path. At the bottom, a green dashed Agentic construction box shows an agent coordinating Short-term Memory and Long-term Memory; a green check marks their connection, contrasting with the red X marks in the first two panels.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
